name: Phobias
overview: Scripture teaches that overcoming fear and anxiety, including phobias, requires trusting fully in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. Galatians 5:16 encourages believers to walk in the Spirit, which empowers us to resist the flesh’s desires that can fuel fear. Additionally, Hebrews 4:12 reminds us that God's Word is living and discerning, able to penetrate deeply into our hearts and transform our thoughts and intentions, providing the spiritual strength needed to confront and overcome fears.
